title.value: Control Netflix and send messages by voice

introduction.value: A user had Alexa+ find and navigate to an anime on Netflix, announce calendar events, and send emails and texts from simple commands.

method.value: The poster had already wired Alexa into a voice-controlled home theater, then used Alexa+ to build routines that let Alexa command itself. For “watch ONE PIECE,” it was told to search Netflix for the anime and step through a couple of select actions to reach playback on the last-opened Netflix profile; a commenter separately says Alexa+ can announce calendar events and send an email or text from simple voice commands.

outcome.value: The result was a working voice shortcut that could jump to the most recent episode and support a broader “Netflix and chill” routine. The main shortfall the post stresses is inconsistency: some commands only worked with very specific wording, and there were occasional service dropouts.

notes.value: The post says the anime routine only worked after using Alexa+ self-control plus a few navigation steps, and other voice-built routines sometimes had to be created twice before they actually worked.

source_text.body:
Control Netflix and send messages by voice
A user had Alexa+ find and navigate to an anime on Netflix, announce calendar events, and send emails and texts from simple commands.
Done with
A+
Alexa+
What they did
The poster had already wired Alexa into a voice-controlled home theater, then used Alexa+ to build routines that let Alexa command itself. For “watch ONE PIECE,” it was told to search Netflix for the anime and step through a couple of select actions to reach playback on the last-opened Netflix profile; a commenter separately says Alexa+ can announce calendar events and send an email or text from simple voice commands.
How it went
The result was a working voice shortcut that could jump to the most recent episode and support a broader “Netflix and chill” routine. The main shortfall the post stresses is inconsistency: some commands only worked with very specific wording, and there were occasional service dropouts.
Worth knowing
The post says the anime routine only worked after using Alexa+ self-control plus a few navigation steps, and other voice-built routines sometimes had to be created twice before they actually worked.
Try it yourself
with
Alexa+
Copy prompt
Alexa, open Netflix and find [show or movie title], then start [episode or season]. Then read out my calendar events for [today or date], and send a text to [contact name] saying [message]. Read each message back to me and wait for my okay before sending it.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/alexa/comments/1n4b1qt
